sam: Scheduling a deploy for runtime-config service today at 2026-03-18T18:00Z. Need final owner acks and a quick checklist before we go: canary 5% -> 100% over 30m, smoke tests green, rollback tag prepared, feature-flag staged. Who's onwatch?

tara: Ack — I'm smoke owner. Will run smoke plan and post results. ETA ~10m.

jordan: Ack from deploy owner. I'll own the canary, watch error budget, and execute rollback if needed. Rollback tag: release/runtime-config@v1.4.3-rollback (ready).

lee: Quick Q — can we add a short latency synthetic during the canary window? I'll wire a check to the dashboard and post thresholds.

ana: (typo fixed) sorry, meant ana: QA ack. No DB schema work here. Recommend keeping new flag off until 1st canary completes.

deploy-bot: Deploy request recorded by sam for 2026-03-18T18:00Z. Scheduled window: 18:00Z-18:40Z UTC. Reminder set for 15 minutes before start.

tara: Smoke plan run: health endpoint, config load, cache warm, error-rate sanity. Commands used: ```bash
curl -fsS https://staging.internal/runtime-config/health | jq .status
# expect: "ok"
``` Results: all green on staging.

jordan: Canary plan: start 5% for 10m, if metrics stable bump to 25% for 10m, then 100% over 10m. Rollback thresholds: error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR 3x increase in p95 latency. Runbook: ops-runbooks/release/runtime-config.md (lines 10-40).

sam: Thanks. I'll flip the final go-toggle at 17:55Z and kick off the canary at 18:00Z unless any last-minute blockers. :thumbsup:

lee: Adding the latency synthetic now, thresholds posted to the canary dashboard. +1 for deploy. :white_check_mark:

ana: QA will be watching logs and customer-facing metrics. I'll ping in #support if I see any anomalous spikes. Ack.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window starts in 10 minutes (2026-03-18T17:50Z).

sam: Closing checklist. Owners: tara (smoke), jordan (deploy), lee (monitoring), ana (QA). If nothing else, proceeding with rollout.

[end of thread]
